concept: Going deeper than the surface-level answer on a topic that interests you
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student picks a topic they're genuinely interested in and is guided through progressively deeper follow-up questions about it
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides how far to keep digging at each stage
exercise.practice: Student identifies one surprising thing they learned by going deeper than they normally would

assessment.success_marker: student reaches at least one insight beyond the first-level, commonly-known answer
